gloss: to produce; to create; to make (a work)

definitions.gloss: to produce; to create; to make (a creative or media work)
definitions.explanation: To create something through a planned process, especially artistic, media, or creative works such as films, programs, artworks, and games.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{制作|せいさく}する。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦アニメ→アニメ：01527_anime⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{制作|せいさく}した。
examples.english: This anime was produced by a Japanese company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}して→協力する：25370_kyouryokusuru⟧⟦{短編|たんぺん}→短編：04512_tanpen⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{制作|せいさく}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The students are working together to produce a short film.

notes:
{制作|せいさく}する is used for creative and media production — films, TV shows, artworks, games, and advertisements. It implies an organized production process. Note the distinction from the near-homophone ⟦{製作|せいさく}→製作：04322_seisaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, which focuses on manufacturing physical products.

USAGE:
- ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{制作|せいさく}する: to produce/create something

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{制作|せいさく}する: to produce a film
- ⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{制作|せいさく}する: to produce a program
- ⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{制作|せいさく}する: to create a work
- ⟦{制作|せいさく}→制作：04320_seisaku⟧⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧: production cost
- ⟦{制作|せいさく}{者|しゃ}→制作者：23765_seisakusha⟧: producer; creator
- ⟦{制作|せいさく}→制作：04320_seisaku⟧⟦{過程|かてい}→過程：02621_katei⟧: production process

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{製作|せいさく}→製作：04322_seisaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to manufacture; to produce — same pronunciation but uses a different kanji; focuses on making physical goods or industrial products
- ⟦{作成|さくせい}する→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧: to create; to prepare — used for documents, plans, and data; more routine and less creative
- ⟦{製造|せいぞう}→製造：03289_seizou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to manufacture — industrial mass production of goods
